text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
—This year's URA Awards ceremony also 
features a star-studded lineup of names.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, moving on to the next award. This 
year's "Best Dirt Umamusume" is—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: It's Espoir City-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Congrats, Espo-san!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! What are you guys doing here? Even 
going out of your way to bring a 
bouquet...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, obviously to celebrate! Julio's here 
too, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Congratulations on the award, Espo-san.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
When this award was announced at the start 
of the year and I saw your name... part of 
me felt that it was only natural.

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
"Because you were strong at the Kashiwa 
Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, truly.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"...Oi, Furioso...? That's an awfully 
strong grip for a congratulatory 
handshake, ain't it...?"

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text: Do you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Don't play dumb with me!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, easy there. Even if we want to 
celebrate, we're still rivals, after all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It's totally natural to feel frustrated. I 
still can't forget how it felt right 
before the finish line at the Champions 
Cup, either.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"I recognize how strong and amazing Espo-n 
was. —That's why next time, I want to 
win."

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
Only by defeating you, a representative of 
Central, can I truly achieve my 
long-cherished ambition.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Be good to Falco too, okay?☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Quit getting cheeky with me! I'll make you 
all bawl your eyes out, bring it on! 
...Brace yourselves and come at me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing greetings with the 
executives and guests, I head over to 
Espoir City. She had asked a certain favor 
of me today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To take a picture of her with the 
trophy." I rush over, taking out my 
smartphone—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ! You're late! I'm already all set here!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Take the damn picture! I'm draggin' every 
last one of 'em into the shot, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaah☆ I'm gonna get caught up in ittt☆

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you're way too close, Falco!! Stop 
clinging all over me!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Oh, count me in too, then.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Tran!? Wait, Furioso too... 
Aaaaaaagh!
choice_data_list: I'll take a few photos, then! Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Good morning, Chief! Congratulations on 
your daughter's award... oh.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
"......That's a nice photo. Is it from the 
awards ceremony?"

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Because they went and sent it to me. ...In 
the family group LANE chat.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after the awards ceremony. I call 
out to Espoir City on her way to school.
choice_data_list:
Did you send that photo to your family 
too?

Did you send that photo to your family 
too?

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Sent it. ...Sent this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Peeking at her smartphone screen, I saw a 
group photo she had taken with her 
friends—
choice_data_list:
Wait! Sorry! The trophy in this photo 
is...

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter if we're in the photo or 
not.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —This was the best one.

text_block_list.name: Training Club Staff
text_block_list.text:
“It is a bit of a shame, though. In this 
photo, her friend is partially blocking 
the young lady's trophy...”

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...It's the opposite. And that's just 
fine for her."

text_block_list.name: Espo's Father
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I grabbed hold of a "pride" far 
more important than any award.
